what: Checks.py cursor auth port omits keychain pre-read
scenario_or_breakage: Darwin lint-fix with no CURSOR_API_KEY but a readable cursor-access-token keychain entry currently pre-reads the token into CURSOR_API_KEY before launching Cursor. The proposed replacement lists only preflight and export, so export can leave the child without the key after the Bash library is deleted.
suggested_fix: Add agents.cursor_preread_service_token() between successful agents.cursor_auth_preflight(...) and agents.cursor_auth_export_env() in the checks.py Cursor path, and pin that lint-fix auth sequence without adding --api-key.
